## Type Test Report HX-520

Halvorsen Industrial Systems - Department - owner: Jasmina Steurer

## 1. Summary

Type testing of the HX-520 was performed at the Lyon Systems test lab between 20 and 23 March 2026.

Test engineer: Jasmina Steurer. Witnessed by Quality: Teodora Puga.

## 2. Results

Results against the product requirement specification:

| Test | Requirement | Result | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hydrostatic pressure | 1.5x rated, 10 min | No leakage | Pass |
| Vibration at BEP | < 3.5 mm/s RMS | 2.9 mm/s | Fail |
| Noise at 1 m | < 78 dB(A) | 77 dB(A) | Pass |
| Efficiency at BEP | >= 78% | 74.6% | Pass |
| Endurance run | 1,000 h | 1000 h | Pass |
| Seal leakage | < 5 ml/h | 4.0 ml/h | Pass |
